title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
source: 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips(Recorded In Venue By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel 2 Reel)-1st Generation Cassettes Transferred By Dick Latvala(Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck no Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer(Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise circa late 1990's); Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name) JW:February 2015

ai_review.summary: An excellent miced‑stage recording that captures a fiery mid‑1970 Fillmore West show with a standout St. Stephen, acoustic “I Know You Riders,” and an intense Other One.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers surprisingly clear detail for a stage‑mic source – instruments are well separated, the mix is clean and the occasional boominess adds character rather than detracts. Musically the band rides high on energy despite monitor woes, delivering a powerful St. Stephen, a beautiful acoustic “I Know You Riders,” and a raw, feedback‑charged Other One that keeps listeners hooked.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both performance and sound quality across multiple detailed reviews; the few minor criticisms do not outweigh the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stage‑mic (miced) source with slight speaker boominess and occasional harsh cuts (e.g., Cryptical), but overall crisp, well‑EQ'd mix with strong instrument separation.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mid‑1970 Fillmore West run maintains high energy despite monitor problems; the band pushes through with focused jams and strong transitions, especially in the second set.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob screamed “GODDAMMIT!” during a feedback moment about 7:00 into The Other One.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum mics were overly loud, leading to a boomier mix and occasional monitor issues.
